rules.statement: The bridge must provide IF-001, a required AHB5 (IHI 0033 Version C) Subordinate interface, clocked by i_clk_core and reset by i_rst_n_core, in configuration CFG-BASE.
The bridge must provide IF-002, a required AXI4 (IHI 0022 Issue H.c) Manager interface, clocked by i_clk_core and reset by i_rst_n_core, in configuration CFG-BASE.
The bridge must provide IF-003, a single required active-low shared reset from the reset controller, with asynchronous assert and SoC-synchronized release before the IP boundary.
AHB and AXI interface signals must use the rising edge of i_clk_core, and i_rst_n_core must be the only reset input.
